# Time Tracking

Manage time tracking entries in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::timeTracking()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\TimeTracking\TimeTracking` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `timeTracking.add`
- `timeTracking.delete`
- `timeTracking.info`
- `timeTracking.list`
- `timeTracking.resume`
- `timeTracking.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ended_after` | Start of period for ended entries (ISO 8601 datetime) |
| `ended_before` | End of period for ended entries (ISO 8601 datetime) |
| `ids` | Array of time tracking entry UUIDs |
| `relates_to` | Filter by related entity (milestone, project, nextgenProject, nextgenProjectGroup) |
| `started_after` | Start of period (ISO 8601 datetime) |
| `started_before` | End of period (ISO 8601 datetime) |
| `subject` | Filter by subject (id and type) |
| `subject_types` | Filter by subject types array |
| `user_id` | Filter by user UUID |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `starts_on` | Sort by the date the entry started |

## Includes

`list()` and `info()` accept the same includes:

`materials`, `relates_to`

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `ADD_FIELDS` | `started_at`, `started_on`, `ended_at`, `duration`, `work_type_id`, `description`, `subject`, `invoiceable`, `user_id` |
| `INCLUDES` | `materials`, `relates_to` |
| `RELATES_TO_TYPES` | `milestone`, `project`, `nextgenProject`, `nextgenProjectGroup` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `started_at`, `started_on`, `duration`, `work_type_id`, `description`, `subject`, `invoiceable` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List time tracking entries with enhanced filtering and sorting

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get time tracking entry information

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a new time tracking entry
Supports three variants:
1. started_at + duration
2. started_at + ended_at
3. started_on + duration (duration tracking mode)

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update a time tracking entry

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a time tracking entry

### `resume()`

```php
resume(string $id, ?string $startedAt = null): array
```

Resume a timer based on previously tracked time

### `forUser()`

```php
forUser(string $userId, array $options = []): array
```

Filter entries by user

### `forSubject()`

```php
forSubject(string $subjectId, string $subjectType, array $options = []): array
```

Filter entries by subject

Note that `nextgenTask` is not accepted here even though time can be
tracked against one — the API offers no such filter value. Use
relatedTo() for project-side filtering.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When the subject type is not a valid filter value

### `forSubjectTypes()`

```php
forSubjectTypes(array $subjectTypes, array $options = []): array
```

Filter entries by subject types

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a subject type is not a valid filter value

### `betweenDates()`

```php
betweenDates(string $startDate, string $endDate, array $options = []): array
```

Filter entries by date range (started)

### `endedBetween()`

```php
endedBetween(string $startDate, string $endDate, array $options = []): array
```

Filter entries by ended date range

### `relatedTo()`

```php
relatedTo(string $entityId, string $entityType, array $options = []): array
```

Filter entries related to a milestone, project, or new projects entity

Valid type values: milestone, project, nextgenProject, nextgenProjectGroup

### `withMaterials()`

```php
withMaterials(): self
```

Fluent interface: Include materials

### `withRelations()`

```php
withRelations(): self
```

Fluent interface: Include relates_to

## Examples

Get all time tracking entries:

```php
$entries = Teamleader::timeTracking()->list();
```

Get entries for specific user:

```php
$entries = Teamleader::timeTracking()->forUser("user-uuid");
```

Get entries within date range:

```php
$entries = Teamleader::timeTracking()->betweenDates("2024-01-01", "2024-01-31");
```

Get entries with materials:

```php
$entries = Teamleader::timeTracking()->withMaterials()->list();
```

Create a time tracking entry:

```php
$entry = Teamleader::timeTracking()->create([
    "started_at" => "2024-01-15T10:00:00+00:00",
    "duration" => 3600,
    "subject" => [
        "id" => "company-uuid",
        "type" => "company"
    ]
]);
```
